name: get_profile
description: Read authoritative current profile, revision, confirmation and missing inputs before updating or calculating.

name: update_profile
description: Propose explicitly supplied facts. This invalidates confirmation. Never use this tool to confirm. Amounts are USD; income/annualSupport are annual, budget monthly, all other money one-time.

patch.description: JSON object string. Allowed keys: dependents and priorities (strings); income, annualSupport, years, mortgage, debts, education, finalExpenses, otherNeeds, employerCoverage, personalCoverage, savings, budget (number or null); educationPlan (object or null). educationPlan fields: annualAmount (number/null), years (integer 1-60/null), scope (combined/per-person/unknown), people (integer 1-30/null). Send partial educationPlan updates as answers arrive. The app calculates education from this basis; never infer years or people. Unknown is null, never zero. Clear educationPlan only for an explicitly stated one-time education total. Main years is support duration 1-60.

name: review_profile
description: Once all required inputs are captured, obtain a compact recap. Preserve all calculation amounts and group $0 exclusions. Do not repeat optional context. Ask Is that correct? and wait for a NEW reply before calculate_needs. No forms. Corrections require an updated recap.

name: calculate_needs
description: Calculate after confirmation of the current review_profile recap. Supply the exact latest affirmative reply in confirmationQuote; already confirmed revisions need no new quote. Returns exact math. Explain it in one paragraph, 3 short sentences, at most 65 words, with one relevant policy tradeoff.

confirmationQuote.description: Exact latest user reply confirming the recap, e.g. Yes, those numbers look right. Must follow review_profile. Do not invent or paraphrase it; never treat a correction as approval. Optional only if this revision was already confirmed.

name: explore_scenario
description: Compare ONE assumption to the confirmed original without changing it. Provide either years OR excludeEmployer; omit both to reset to original.

years.description: Optional hypothetical support period, 1 to 60 years.

excludeEmployer.description: Optional hypothetical that employer coverage is unavailable.

name: show_education
description: Open a comparison popup for a key detail with charts, term/whole-life toggle and tradeoffs. No quotes or product purchase.

focus.description: The relevant captured highlight to explore. Defaults to support.
